About

Lumen Picture Works

We're a wedding photography studio based in Fairview, Boise, working with couples who'd rather be photographed than posed.

Most of our work is documentary: we stay out of the way, watch what's happening, and shoot it as it comes. Where a portrait needs directing we'll direct it, then get out of the frame again.

Our clients have rated us 5.0 out of 5 across 71 Google reviews — the fastest way to see what working with us is actually like.

Services

What we shoot

Coverage built around your schedule, not a fixed package sheet.

Reels & Social Cuts

Short vertical edits delivered within days, so you have something to share while everyone is still talking about it.

Wedding Day Coverage

Full-day documentary coverage from morning haldi through to the reception, with a second shooter where the schedule needs one.

Pre-Wedding Shoot

A relaxed half-day session at a location that means something to you — the best way to get comfortable in front of the camera before the wedding.

Cinematic Wedding Film

A short film cut from the day's real audio and moments, plus a longer edit of the full ceremony.

Engagement & Roka

Coverage for the smaller functions that often get overlooked but are usually the warmest.

Album Design & Printing

Hand-sequenced albums in archival print, designed with you rather than mailed out for approval.

Process

How booking works

No mystery, no surprises — here is exactly what happens from your first message.

Say hello

Send us your dates and venues. We'll confirm availability the same day.

Meet the team

A call or coffee to talk through the schedule, family dynamics and the shots that matter to you.

Lock the date

A signed brief and booking advance holds your date. No date is held without one.

The day itself

We arrive early, stay out of the way, and shoot what actually happens.

Your gallery

A private online gallery of edited images, plus your films and album drafts.

Questions

Before you get in touch

How far in advance should we book?
Peak wedding dates in Boise go early — the sooner you check, the better. Send us your dates and we'll tell you honestly whether we're free.
Do you travel outside Boise?
Yes. Travel and stay are quoted separately and agreed upfront, with no surprises added later.
When do we get our photos?
You'll get a set of previews within days of the wedding, and the full edited gallery after that. We confirm exact timelines in writing when you book.
Can we ask for specific shots?
Please do. A shortlist of family groupings and must-have moments makes the day run faster for everyone.
What's the fastest way to reach you?
WhatsApp. Tap the button anywhere on this page and your message comes straight to us.
